User.title: User
User.description: User profile and role record associated with Firebase Authentication UID in FoodLink Solidario.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

name.description: Full name of the user or contact person.

email.description: Registered email address of the user.

role.description: Role of the user in the platform (only buyer or seller).

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL or empty string.

organizationName.description: Organization or establishment name represented by the user.

verified.description: Whether the user's email/account has been verified.

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used by the account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores authenticated user profiles and their active role (buyer or seller).
